title: Viral Extraction from Sediment
author: Aditi K. Narayanan
materials: 20mM tetrasodium pyrophosphate solution (0.532g in water for 100mL final volume), CAS #7722-88-5, Millipore-Sigma Cat. #P8010 10% NaCl solution (10g in water for 100mL final volume), CAS #7647-14-5 30% Nycodenz solution (4.5g in water for 15mL final volume). Nycodenz is also called Histodenz or Iohexol), CAS #66108-95-0, Millipore-Sigma Cat. #D2158 50% Nycodenz solution (7.5g in water for 15mL final volume) 15mL Falcon tubes or similar (e.g. Fiusher Scientific Cat. #4-959-49B), capable of withstanding ~4000xg Sonication wand (e.g. QSonica CL-188) Centrifuge capable of holding 15mL Falcon Tubes (e.g. Beckman Coulter Allegra X-15R Centrifuge with SX4570 swinging bucket rotor) Syringes, various volumes Hypodermic needles, between preferably 3-4 inches in length if possible (otherwise 1.5 inches will do) Glutaraldehyde solution (optional, for fixation) Liquid nitrogen (optional, for storage after fixation)

steps.title: Prepare Sample Mixture
steps.instruction: Mix the sediment sample with NaCl and tetrasodium pyrophosphate solutions to achieve a final volume of 6mL with concentrations of 2.5% NaCl and 5mM tetrasodium pyrophosphate.

substeps.instruction: Add 4X stock solutions of NaCl and tetrasodium pyrophosphate (e.g., for 1mL slurry, add 1.5mL 4X tetrasodium pyrophosphate, 1.5mL 4X NaCl, and 2mL virus-free water).
Mix in a 15mL Falcon tube and shake to remove any clumps.

steps.title: Sonicate Sample
steps.instruction: Sonicate the mixture on ice using a QSonica CL-188 sonicator.

substeps.instruction: Repeat this cycle 2 more times (total sonication time: 30 seconds).

steps.title: Create Nycodenz Gradient
steps.instruction: Create a 30% and 50% Nycodenz gradient in a 15mL Falcon tube using the underlay method.

substeps.instruction: Fill a syringe with 1mL of 30% solution, remove air bubbles, and dispense into the bottom of the Falcon tube.
Fill a syringe with 1mL of 50% solution and remove air bubbles.
Push the needle to the bottom of the tube and carefully dispense the 50% solution under the 30% solution, allowing the 30% layer to rise.

steps.title: Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Layer the sonicated sample over the Nycodenz gradient and centrifuge at 2900xg for 30 minutes using a swinging bucket rotor.

steps.title: Recover Viral Fractions
steps.instruction: Use a needle and syringe to extract the topwater, the 30% fraction, and the liquid portion of the 50% fraction.

substeps.instruction: Note: Use SYBR Gold staining to determine which fraction contains the highest number of viruses.

steps.title: Filter and Store Viral Fractions
steps.instruction: Filter the viral fraction through a 0.2µm membrane.

substeps.instruction: Optional fixation: Mix with glutaraldehyde to a final concentration of 0.1%.
If fixing, incubate at 4°C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Optional Repeat Extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat the extraction process on the remaining sediment pellet to maximize efficiency.

substeps.instruction: Add 5-6mL of a 1:1 solution (final concentration 5mM tetrasodium pyrophosphate and 2.5% NaCl).
Repeat the sonication, gradient, centrifugation, and recovery steps.
